description: This file defines a PHP trait 'BuzzAnniversaryServiceTrait' within the 'OrangeHRM' project, which provides a method to access the 'BuzzAnniversaryService' via a service container. It is part of the plugin located in the 'orangehrmBuzzPlugin' namespace and is used to facilitate dependency injection and service retrieval within that context.

methods.name: getBuzzAnniversaryService
methods.description: Returns an instance of BuzzAnniversaryService by retrieving it from the service container.
